about: A sample style. The visual owns the top of the frame and you the bottom, beat by beat, on a paper ground: an animation built for each line fills the top panel, then your face takes the whole frame again within 8 seconds. A number you say becomes a counter climbing to it. A real page only where it proves the line. Captions are one plain white word at the seam. Set "variant": "cutout" under layout and your head breaks out of your card onto the paper.
format: talking-head videos split in half: the visual above, the speaker below
